services.desc: Full Membership packages entitle purchasers to unlimited full-season access to the club during regular hours, eligibility for children to join the swim and dive teams, discounts on use of the facility for social functions and discounts on swim lessons. All new members must purchase the required number of bond shares as part of their initial application for membership. The total number of bond shares that the club offers is limited to ensure that the facilities are not crowded and that all members can enjoy the activities of their choice. services.name: Group Lessons
services.desc: Would you prefer a one-on-one setting for you or your children to learn how to swim, to hone your stroke mechanics and endurance, or even to improve your racing technique? Private swim lessons at Raccoon Valley are ideal for adults and children of all ages. We'll craft a program to meet your needs and provide individualized attention. Private lessons are held throughout the summer at dates and times convenient to the student and instructor, and based on pool availability. You can schedule a half-hour lesson at any time with one of our certified swim instructors.
